Five merged PRs since 2026-04-16 added or removed a line containing `voidedValue` under `src`. Best first:

1. **#842** (merged 2026-10-13, commit `b0d8fd2`): adds new `voidedValue` assertions in the "values fed back after loading" block of `openmrs-esm-form-engine-lib/src/adapters/obs-adapter.test.ts` (lines 1566–1921).
2. **#826** (merged 2026-10-05, commit `0e1edc2`): changes `openmrs-esm-form-engine-lib/src/adapters/encounter-diagnosis-adapter.test.ts:206` from `toBe(undefined)` to `toBeNull()`, and rewrites `voidedValue` assertions in `openmrs-esm-form-engine-lib/src/processors/encounter/encounter-payloads.golden.test.ts` (lines 1524–1531 at HEAD).
3. **#822** (merged 2026-10-02, commit `ebb02b7`): changes `voidedValue` reads in `processObsGroup`, `prepareOrders` and `prepareDiagnosis` in `openmrs-esm-form-engine-lib/src/processors/encounter/encounter-processor-helper.ts` (lines 245–298 and 436–437 at HEAD).
4. **#812** (merged 2026-09-22, commit `ae1b2b2`): adds `voidedValue: null` to the `withSubmission` helper in `openmrs-esm-form-engine-lib/src/processors/encounter/encounter-form-processor.test.ts`. I did not get a HEAD line number for this helper, so it has no span in the JSON.
5. **#787** (merged 2026-08-20, commit `a6f911c`): adds the `voidedValue` parameter to `withSubmission` in `openmrs-esm-form-engine-lib/src/processors/encounter/encounter-processor-helper.test.ts` (lines 39–41 at HEAD).

Dates are the commit timestamps on the default branch, which I took as the merge dates. Pinned head is `b0d8fd2`, the newest commit on that branch.

Checked and excluded: #838 (`c79bf02`), #756 (`b99cb4c`), #740 (`bda295e`), #742 (`2204ac0`), #843 (`c0c4765`), #783 (`4db319f`), #800 (`dc54224`), #759 (`242dbac`), #767 (`208fcc7`). Their diffs contain no `voidedValue` lines. `12c24b6` has no PR number and is not counted; its diff does not touch `voidedValue` either.

Coverage caveat: I checked every commit that touches a file currently containing `voidedValue`. A commit that added and later removed such a line in a file that no longer has one would not show up in that search, so it could be missing from this list.
